title: Delhi HC seeks police response to Sharjeel Imam's fresh plea for bail in Delhi riots case
description: The Delhi High Court on Friday sought the response of the Delhi police on a bail plea by Sharjeel Imam in the Delhi riots conspiracy case.The Division Bench of Justice Prathiba M Singh and Justice Vikas Mahajan issued notice in the matter today.
